scope.matter: positive-density irrotational pressureless dust before caustics
scope.geometry: finite dust world tube plus exterior; spherical homogeneous macroscopic reference only
scope.clock: future-oriented dust proper time inside dust; exterior slicing separately specified
scope.claim: candidate-specific classical correspondence and independent regularity; no universal CST theorem

reference.kind: classical coupled Einstein dust, not a CST history ensemble
reference.exterior: Schwarzschild with mass M; regular coordinates if needed
reference.surface: comoving, zero pressure, no surface layer; [h_ab]=[K_ab]=0
reference.initial_constraint: Rdot0=-sqrt(2*G*M/R0); do not fix Rdot0 independently
reference.scope_limit: compact pre-singularity interval only; the reference later becomes singular

scales.lambda: CST counting density, length^-4; not dust density rho
scales.Lk: physical nonlocality scale; freeze before validation
scales.Lcg: physical averaging scale; freeze before validation
scales.numerical: mesh/time step/cutoff at fixed physical model
scales.statistical: independent realization count; not geometric refinement
scales.continuum: lambda increases at fixed physical region and stated matching of couplings/state
scales.physical_scale: varying ell or nu as a physical constant is a separate model-family question

candidate_closure.item: Complete finite/regulated marked poset carrier and 4D selection without selecting on bounce
Explicit dust variables, discrete matter action/constraints and invariant matter measure
BDG normalization, nonlocality choice, sector weights zeta_N and boundary/corner terms
Initial state, physical inner product, normalizable amplitude/decoherence construction
Relational current, density, spatial volume, curvature and coarse-fibre weights
Full-region matching, exterior slicing, omitted exterior contributions and causal extension
Run manifest: actual densities, sample size/power, uncertainty method, seeds and compute budget

pilot_test.purpose: first finite-sample correspondence screen, not a continuum-limit theorem
pilot_test.missing_run_parameters_decision: HOLD; must freeze D7 before generating validation data
pilot_test.multiplicity: simultaneous interval over all preregistered primary mass/time/observable comparisons
pilot_test.decision: PASS only if full simultaneous uncertainty interval lies inside every tolerance band; disjoint interval FAIL; overlap HOLD
pilot_test.uncertainty: include sampling, operator, coarse map, initial state, boundary and numerical terms; no undeclared independence
pilot_test.tolerance_status: protocol design choices, not physical constants or post hoc fits

regularity.default_claim: bounded and convergent declared physical moments on a fixed interval/domain
regularity.rho_scale: M/V0 for the declared mass, fixed across refinement
regularity.localization: relational detector cells xi at fixed physical Lcg; cover the entire declared domain including one-sided surface limits or justified resolved transition
regularity.requirement: common finite bounds + uniform integrability + controlled convergence over n, T in I and relational cells xi in the claimed domain
regularity.constants: derive bounds C_rho,C_K from candidate before validation; never use sample maxima as universal bounds
regularity.operator_assumptions: positive physical measure / spectral distribution or specified measurement instrument; domains preserved

volume_tail_sufficient_only.condition: sup_n,T P(V_n(T)<=v)<=C*v^(2+delta), delta>0; constants common and dimensionally consistent

stronger_claims_require: control of relevant tidal components/physical frame
separate causal extension or completeness proof
not_implied: bounded curvature from bounded mean volume
regularity.failure_scope: failed sufficient proxy alone does not refute physical regularity; validated physical counterexample does

checkpoint_schedule.trigger: every correspondence level, time window and mass
any proposed bounce or trapping event

requirements.carrier: Historienträger und markenerhaltende Symmetriequotienten vollständig definiert
requirements.action_measure: Gesamtwirkung, Materiemaß, Sektorengewichte und Randdaten fixiert
requirements.quantum_consistency: Zustand, Normierung und Komposition bzw. Dekohärenzfunktional konsistent
requirements.coarse_map: Relationale Observablen und physikalischer Abgleich definiert

requirements.definition: Intrinsische Strom-/Flussdefinition mit Einheiten und Kontinuumsbezug
requirements.conservation: Bilanz einschließlich zeitartiger Oberfläche und Unsicherheit
requirements.calibration: Bias, Varianz, Auflösung und Gebietseinfluss kontrolliert

requirements.eligibility: Gekoppelter Kandidat, zulässige Präparation und unabhängiger Testplan fixiert
requirements.dynamics: Radius, Dichte, Hubble-Rate und Beschleunigung im gemeinsamen Fehlerbudget
requirements.mass_response: Massenerhaltung und Massenantwort bei erfüllten Anfangszwängen

requirements.event: Mehrzeitiges Ereignis und Zeitfenster vorab eindeutig definiert

requirements.operators: Physikalische Dichte-/Krümmungsobservablen, Domänen und Maße begründet
requirements.bounds: Gemeinsame Schranken für Dichte- und Krümmungsmomente bewiesen
requirements.tails: Unbeobachtete Tails und uniforme Integrierbarkeit kontrolliert
requirements.refinement: Grenzprozess, physikalischer Abgleich und Konvergenz kontrolliert
requirements.time_domain: Aussage über das gesamte deklarierte Zeitintervall und Raumgebiet

requirements.domain: Materieoberfläche, Außenraum und Rechengrenze getrennt definiert
requirements.cross_intervals: Kausale Beziehungen und Wirkungsbeiträge über die Materieoberfläche erhalten
requirements.junction: Anschlussgesetz und gegebenenfalls Oberflächenstress aus derselben Theorie

requirements.definition: Fläche, Nullrichtungen, Orientierung und Expansionen definiert
requirements.dynamical_evidence: Dynamisch erzeugte gefangene oder marginale Flächen nachgewiesen

requirements.dictionary: Geometrischer bzw. operationaler Begriff der Fortsetzung festgelegt
requirements.coverage: Geltungsbereich umfasst die behauptete Durchgangsregion einschließlich Rand/Außenraum

budget.allowed_now: local deterministic protocol checks and analytic reference controls

change_control.semantic_change: new version before new validation data; rerun affected decisions
change_control.after_data_change: label exploratory and use fresh validation data for confirmation
change_control.identity: SHA-256 of contract bytes + run manifest + input hashes in every record
change_control.scope_change: periodic cell to finite ball, new exterior, matter law or physical scale requires explicit new scope
